coaching.headline: The duo lane bled Sparrow dry and allied jungle control took every pit; the enemy finished with zero objective damage.

flags.text: Skylar took first blood and seven of Sparrow's nine deaths, dying once all game.
Khaimera secured both Fangtooths, the Mini Prime and all three Seedlings with 15335 objective damage.
Lt. Belica scored three offlane kills without dying, one on Greystone fourteen seconds after Khaimera died there.
The only lost fight was on the duo lane: Sparrow killed Skylar and Steel, Greystone killed Khaimera.

focus.title: Kill, cash, reset
focus.action: Turn every won fight into the next pit or tower, as the Fangtooth after the duo-and-mid sweep did, and after a kill in the enemy half, Skylar and Steel reset together.

7.call: Lost 1-3 on the duo lane in the enemy half: the kill on Dekker came first, then three allied deaths. The next won fight still delivered Fangtooth.

18.call: Lt. Belica killed Argus and Bayle killed Greystone on the offlane, both after the enemy duo outer fell. With two enemies down, the next call is the nearest offlane structure.

8.6.call: Won 3-0 across the duo and mid lanes, Skylar on Sparrow, Steel on Dekker and Lt. Belica on Argus, and Khaimera took Fangtooth right after. Sound conversion; repeat the same order.

17.1.call: Two separate plays: Lt. Belica killed Aurora on the offlane, Skylar and Khaimera killed Dekker and Sparrow on the duo lane, then Steel took the enemy duo outer. Clean conversion of a duo-lane win.

The lone death came one second after the kill on Dekker, with Steel dying two seconds later. Before chasing deep on the duo lane, check where Greystone was last seen.
40ad3669-1455-4dbb-8557-3525356ba9d9: Zero deaths and 12621 hero damage, third among all ten players, plus a kill on Greystone. When Aurora's Hoarfrost root is spent, keep trading on the offlane.

2f1ce887-716b-41db-9ab2-bac35ae9460e: Took 80 of 168 jungle minions out of the enemy jungle: damn rude, and exactly right. Whenever Greystone shows on a lane, invade the far side again.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Kill participation hit 47% with three kills and six assists, and the enemy duo outer tower fell to this support. Whenever Skylar holds a kill lead, keep pressing together.
Four wards on an own average of 6.1, and a death to Greystone outside any detected fight in the enemy half. Before entering the enemy half, ward first.

matchup: Duo lane was against Sparrow and Dekker; allied duo deaths before minute ten ran two against six.
Sparrow finished on 5909 gold against 10054 for this carry, with only Vanquisher completed.
build: Plasma Blade and Vanquisher are two of three items in the most played core into Sparrow; Imperator is the missing third.
Plasma Blade stacks critical chance on basic attacks against heroes; Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Vanquisher was bought second, so seven of the nine kills came before the execute was owned.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles at heroes below a health threshold; Forage adds gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Thraex leads a toss-up in this carry field with Weald close behind; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair.
augment: Assault MK-II makes Air Assault hover longer and fire an additional missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II leads a toss-up in this carry field and is the most played pick. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier is the Best crest in this carry field, ahead of Liberator.
improvement: The best common core for this carry is Lightning Hawk, Scattershot and Equinox at 52.9%; into Sparrow, Imperator completes the 50.5% core.
Pacifier over Liberator is the Best crest swap: a dash and empowered physical hit, giving up the cleanse and shield.

matchup: Lane opponent was Aurora, the enemy's top hero damage at 11135, while this offlaner never died.
Magical damage made up 8462 of the 13212 hero damage taken, with Aurora the main magical threat.
build: Augmentation was the only finished item: after an ability cast, the next basic attack deals bonus on-hit damage.
Nyr Warboots carries the only magical armor in the build, against a magic-heavy lane.
eternal: Marrow heals from hero damage, more at missing health; Jealousy adds damage as health falls.
Idrisil leads a toss-up in this offlane field, and Marrow ranks behind several picks.
Blood Bank with Jealousy is the best Marrow pair; Leech, the first minor here, clearly trails Blood Bank.
augment: Swift Strikes adds attack speed to one basic attack after each ability cast, the same trigger Augmentation uses.
Betrayer's Reqiuem leans first in this offlane field; Swift Strikes ranks third, behind Frenzied Fighter.
crest: Nyr Warboots' active grants decaying movement speed and regenerates a share of max health over a few seconds.
Gravitum leads a toss-up in this offlane field; Nyr Warboots ranks behind Saphir's Mantle and Iceskorn Talons.
improvement: The best common core for this offlaner is Overlord, Tainted Blade and Rapture at 61.4%; none were built.
Blood Bank for Leech is the Best first minor: lifesteal from stored hero damage, giving up the enemy regen cut.
Betrayer's Reqiuem over Swift Strikes is the field lean: Kingslayer uppercuts an area, giving up the attack-speed basic.

matchup: Jungle opponent Greystone scored only two kills, this jungler and Steel, both in the enemy half.
Healing of 11054 led all ten players, ahead of Greystone's 9766.
build: Overlord was the only finished item: basic attacks cleave nearby targets, and kills grant permanent health.
Saphir's Mantle is the only magical armor in the build.
eternal: Nihil builds Doom stats while damaging heroes, growing on level-ups and takedowns; From the Abyss heals in combat or out of vision.
Lotus leans first in this jungle field; Knell and Nihil sit close behind.
From the Abyss with Adaptive Plating is the best Nihil pair. Sound keep.
augment: Jungle Invasion is the Best augment in this jungle field, ahead of Feral Ambush.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's active grows size and max health briefly, deals true damage nearby, then adds permanent health.
Pacifier leads a toss-up in this jungle field; Saphir's Mantle ranks near the bottom of the ranked crests.
improvement: The best common core for this jungler is Malady, Terminus and Necrosis at 62.6%; none were built.
Jungle Invasion over Feral Ambush is the field-backed swap: jungle physical power, doubled in the enemy jungle, giving up Ambush range.

matchup: Lane opponent Argus finished 0/3/1 with 4517 hero damage, the lowest of all ten players.
This midlaner wins 48.9% of field games into Argus, so two kills without a death beat the field read.
build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings are two thirds of both the best core and the most played core into Argus.
Combustion adds area damage on ability hits, with a cooldown cut on hero damage; Wraith Leggings boosts ability damage on low-health heroes.
Wraith Leggings was bought last, so earlier fights ran without Wraith Leggings.
eternal: Lotus grants random damage, haste, speed or health every two minutes and on takedowns; Immaculate cuts damage taken at high health.
Lotus leans first in this midlane field. Sound keep; Early Bloom with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience growing with level.
Combat Veteran is the Best augment in this midlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a few seconds.
Soulbearer leans first in this midlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: The best common core for this midlaner is Combustion, Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown at 57.9%; Oblivion Crown is the missing third.
Early Bloom over Flawless is the Best first minor: a bonus level at twelve, giving up ally heals; level 14 was reached.

matchup: Duo lane opponent was Dekker, killed twice by this support and four times overall.
Dekker's Stasis Bomb and Ion Strike both stun in an area; wait both out before Shield Slam.
build: Heavy Metal scales with total physical and magical armor; Xenia adds both, Dynamo adds physical armor.
Xenia shields a nearby ally, once per target per cooldown; Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take more damage briefly.
Dynamo was bought last, so earlier fights ran without the damage-taken debuff.
eternal: Krix adds max health and size by level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates after a break from hero damage; Cannibalism adds health per takedown.
Knell leans first in this support field and Krix trails; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical on-hit damage to punches and Shield Bash, based on total armor.
Heavy Metal leads a toss-up in this support field and is the most played pick. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's active shields self and nearby heroes and adds tenacity while the shield holds; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Leafsong leans first in this support field; Sanctification sits level with Rift Walkers behind.
improvement: The best common core for this support is Fire Blossom, Forticus and Tainted Guard at 63.9%; none were built.
Leafsong over Sanctification is the field lean: an ally speed burst and slow immunity, giving up the shield and tenacity.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
enemyKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health
